game_conf:
title = Mineclonia
description = A survival sandbox game. Survive, gather, hunt, build, explore, and do much more.
textdomain = mcl_game_meta
disallowed_mapgens = v6
first_mod = mcl_init
last_mod = _mcl_autogroup
min_minetest_version = 5.10
release = 39603
author = ryvnf
scope: All source modules. Literal registrations are navigation hints; generated definitions and callbacks need runtime and behavioral review.

modules.name: mcl_aliases
modules.description: provides backward compatibility aliases for legacy items and nodes

modules.name: mcl_armor_stand_compat
modules.description: Handles legacy armor stand entities

modules.name: mcl_compass_compat
modules.description: backwards compatiblity definitions

modules.name: mcl_dye
modules.description: dummy mod for dependency reasons and to provide compatibility with Mineclone 2 and VoxeLibre

modules.name: mcl_map_dross
modules.description: removes bad items, nodes and entities from the map

modules.name: mcl_mushrooms_compat
modules.description: convert legacy huge mushroom blocks

modules.name: mcl_pistons_compat
modules.description: replace legacy pistons

modules.name: mcl_signs_compat
modules.description: Registers LBMs to update old standing signs' names

modules.name: _mcl_autogroup
modules.description: Mineclonia core mod which automatically adds groups to all items. Very important for digging times.

modules.name: flowlib
modules.description: Simple flow functions for use in Minetest mods by Qwertymine3

modules.name: mcl_attached
modules.description: Adds additional ways for nodes to be attached.

modules.name: mcl_autogroup
modules.description: Mineclonia core mod which automatically adds groups to all items. Very important for digging times.

modules.name: mcl_colors
modules.description: The HTML sequences for the minecraft colors

modules.name: mcl_damage
modules.description: Minecraft-like damage reason system

modules.name: mcl_explosions
modules.description: A common API to create explosions.

modules.name: mcl_init
modules.description: Initialization mod of Mineclonia. Defines some common shared variables and sets up initial default settings which have to be set at the beginning.

modules.name: mcl_liquids
modules.description: This mod adds an alternative liquid transformation system.

modules.name: mcl_loot
modules.description: API for filling a chest with random treasures.

modules.name: mcl_sounds
modules.description: This mod contains the core sounds of Mineclonia as well as helper function for mods to access them.

modules.name: mcl_util
modules.description: Helper functions for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_walkover
modules.description: Some mode developers have shown an interest in having an `on_walk_over` event. This is useful for pressure-plates and the like.

modules.name: mcl_worlds
modules.description: Utility functions for worlds and the “dimensions”.

modules.name: tga_encoder
modules.description: A TGA Encoder written in Lua without the use of external Libraries.

modules.name: mcl_attachments
modules.description: Facilities for consistent spatial treatment of attached entities

modules.name: mcl_boats
modules.description: Adds drivable boats.

modules.name: mcl_burning
modules.description: Burning Objects for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_charges
modules.description: Adds Code to easily register throwable charges like the wind charge

modules.name: mcl_dripping
modules.description: Drops are generated rarely under solid nodes

modules.name: mcl_falling_nodes
modules.description: Falling node entities, Minecraft-style

modules.name: mcl_item_entity
modules.description: Dropped items will be attracted to the player like a magnet.

modules.name: mcl_minecarts
modules.description: Minecarts are vehicles to move players quickly on rails.

modules.name: mcl_mobs
modules.description: Mob API for mineclonia, originally based on mobs_redo.

modules.name: mcl_paintings
modules.description: The paintings mod for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_wither_spawning
modules.description: Wither Spawning for Mineclonia

modules.name: mobs_mc
modules.description: Adds Minecraft-like monsters and animals.

modules.name: mcl_lightning
modules.description: A mod that adds thunder and lightning effects.

modules.name: mcl_moon
modules.description: Adds moon phases to the game

modules.name: mcl_void_damage
modules.description: Deal damage to entities stuck in the deep void

modules.name: mcl_weather
modules.description: Weather and sky handling: Rain, snow, thunderstorm, End and Nether ambience

modules.name: doc
modules.description: A simple in-game documentation system which enables mods to add help entries based on templates.

modules.name: doc_identifier
modules.description: Adds a tool which shows help entries about almost anything which it punches.

modules.name: doc_items
modules.description: Adds automatically generated help texts for items.

modules.name: mcl_craftguide
modules.description: The most comprehensive Crafting Guide on Minetest.

modules.name: mcl_doc
modules.description: This Mineclonia mod sets up and configures the Help modpack mods to tailor the help towards Mineclonia.

modules.name: mcl_doc_basics
modules.description: Adds some help texts explaining how to use Mineclonia.

modules.name: mcl_tt
modules.description: Add Mineclonia tooltips

modules.name: tt
modules.description: Support for custom tooltip extensions for items

modules.name: awards
modules.description: Adds awards to Minetest, and an API to register new ones.

modules.name: hudbars
modules.description: Replaces the health and breath symbols in the HUD by “progress bars” and shows exact values. Other mods can add more progress bars for custom player stats.

modules.name: mcl_achievements
modules.description: Adds Mineclonia Archievements

modules.name: mcl_base_textures
modules.description: Provides core textures needed by Minetest.

modules.name: mcl_bossbars
modules.description: Show enderdragon & wither boss bars. Also allows custom bars.

modules.name: mcl_credits
modules.description: Show a HUD containing the credits

modules.name: mcl_death_messages
modules.description: Shows messages in chat when a player dies.

modules.name: mcl_experience
modules.description: eXPerience mod

modules.name: mcl_formspec
modules.description: Helper mod to simplify creation of formspecs a little bit

modules.name: mcl_formspec_prepend
modules.description: Formspec prepend for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_hbarmor
modules.description: Adds a HUD bar displaying the current damage of the player's armor.

modules.name: mcl_info
modules.description: Prints biome name and player position

modules.name: mcl_inventory
modules.description: Adds the player inventory and creative inventory.

modules.name: mcl_title
modules.description: Add an API to add in HUD title

modules.name: show_wielded_item
modules.description: Displays the name of the wielded item.

modules.name: mcl_pistons
modules.description: adds pistons

modules.name: mcl_amethyst
modules.description: Amethyst related stuff

modules.name: mcl_anvils
modules.description: Anvils mods for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_armor
modules.description: Adds craftable armor that is visible to other players.

modules.name: mcl_armor_stand
modules.description: Adds an armor stand for armor storage and display.

modules.name: mcl_banners
modules.description: Adds decorative banners in different colors which can be emblazoned with patterns, offering a countless number of combinations.

modules.name: mcl_beehives
modules.description: Adds beehives and bee nests to Mineclonia.

modules.name: mcl_books
modules.description: Books mod for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_bows
modules.description: This mod adds bows and arrows for Mineclonia.

modules.name: mcl_buckets
modules.description: depends = mcl_worlds, mcl_util, controls, mcl_core, mclx_core, doc

modules.name: mcl_cake
modules.description: Add cakes to mcl

modules.name: mcl_cartography_table
modules.description: Adds the cartography table villager workstation to Mineclonia. Used to copy and create maps.

modules.name: mcl_clock
modules.description: A fantasy clock item roughly shows the time of day.

modules.name: mcl_cocoas
modules.description: Cocoa pods which grow at jungle trees. Does not include cocoa beans.

modules.name: mcl_colorblocks
modules.description: Adds blocks which can be colored, namely hardened clay.

modules.name: mcl_compass
modules.description: A compass item which points towards the world origin.

modules.name: mcl_composters
modules.description: Composters can convert various organic items into bonemeal.

modules.name: mcl_copper
modules.description: Adds Copper Ore, blocks and items.

modules.name: mcl_core
modules.description: Core items of Mineclonia: Basic biome blocks (dirt, sand, stones, etc.), derived items, glass, sugar cane, cactus, barrier, mining tools, hand, craftitems, and misc. items which don't really fit anywhere else.

modules.name: mcl_crafting_table
modules.description: Adds a crafting table.

modules.name: mcl_dripstone
modules.description: adds dripstone

modules.name: mcl_enchanting
modules.description: Enchanting for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_fireworks
modules.description: Adds fun fireworks to the game which players can use.

modules.name: mcl_fishing
modules.description: Adds fish and fishing poles to go fishing.

modules.name: mcl_fletching_table
modules.description: Adds the fletching table villager workstation to Mineclonia.

modules.name: mcl_grindstone
modules.description: Add block that disenchants tools and armour except for curses, and repairs two items of the same type it is also the weapon smith's work station.

modules.name: mcl_heads
modules.description: Small decorative head blocks.

modules.name: mcl_honey
modules.description: Mineclonia mod that adds honey and honeycomb and the respective block versions.

modules.name: mcl_hoppers
modules.description: It's just a clone of Minecraft hoppers, functions nearly identical to them minus mesecons making them stop and the way they're placed.

modules.name: mcl_jukebox
modules.description: Jukebox and music discs are used to play background music on a per-player basis.

modules.name: mcl_lanterns
modules.description: Add lanterns and chains to Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_loom
modules.description: Adds the loom villager workstation to Mineclonia. Used to add patterns to banners.

modules.name: mcl_monster_eggs
modules.description: Adds infested blocks: Blocks which which disguise themselves as stone blocks and spawn a silverfish when broken.

modules.name: mcl_mud
modules.description: Adds various mud blocks.

modules.name: mcl_ocean
modules.description: Includes various ocean nodes

modules.name: mcl_portals
modules.description: Adds buildable portals to the Nether and End dimensions.

modules.name: mcl_powder_snow
modules.description: adds powder snow

modules.name: mcl_raw_ores
modules.description: Adds raw iron and raw gold.

modules.name: mcl_sponges
modules.description: A sponge which sucks in water (WIP).

modules.name: mcl_spyglass
modules.description: This mod adds a spyglass, which is an item that can be used for zooming in on specific locations.

modules.name: mcl_stonecutter
modules.description: This mod adds a stonecutter, which is used to cut stone like materials, and used as the jobsite for the Stone Mason Villager.

modules.name: mcl_torches
modules.description: Mesh-based torches - three dimensional torches for minetest.

modules.name: mclx_core
modules.description: Core items not found in Minecraft

modules.name: mclx_fences
modules.description: Additional fences and fence gates

modules.name: mclx_stairs
modules.description: Additional stairs and slabs not found in Minecraft 1.11

modules.name: mcl_biome_dispatch
modules.description: Abstractions over the engine biome system and mcl_levelgen's

modules.name: mcl_biomes
modules.description: Adds the various biomes and biome-related things.

modules.name: mcl_dungeons
modules.description: Generates random dungeons in the world

modules.name: mcl_end_island
modules.description: Generate the end main island for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_levelgen
modules.description: Minecraft-like asynchronous level generator

modules.name: mcl_mapgen_core
modules.description: The core of the Mineclonia mapgen

modules.name: mcl_mapgen_models
modules.description: Lua recreations of the built-in map generators

modules.name: mcl_strongholds
modules.description: Generates strongholds with end portals in the Overworld

modules.name: mcl_structures
modules.description: Structure placement for Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_villages
modules.description: This mod adds settlements on world generation.

modules.name: tsm_railcorridors
modules.description: Adds simple underground mines with railways and occasional treasure chests.

modules.name: findbiome
modules.description: Adds commands to list and find biomes

modules.name: mcl_commands
modules.description: Mineclonia commands

modules.name: mcl_privs
modules.description: Shared privileges in Mineclonia

modules.name: mcl_temp_helper_recipes
modules.description: Temporary helper recipes.

modules.name: mcl_wip
modules.description: Development mod for Mineclonia which add a “WIP” (Work In Progress) comment to items which are considered to be very unfinished.

modules.name: mcl_death_drop
modules.description: Makes all items in inventory drop after player death.

modules.name: mcl_hunger
modules.description: Adds a simple hunger meachanic with satiation, food poisoning and different healing.

modules.name: mcl_meshhand
modules.description: Applies the player skin texture to the hand.

modules.name: mcl_player
modules.description: Various player effects and player globalstep API

modules.name: mcl_serverplayer
modules.description: Client mod for mcl_localplayer

modules.name: mcl_skins
modules.description: Advanced player skin customization.

modules.name: mcl_spawn
modules.description: Set and get the player's respawn position

modules.name: mcl_sprint
modules.description: Allows the player to sprint by pressing the “Use” key (default: E).

modules.name: mcl_wieldview
modules.description: Makes hand wielded items visible to other players.

modules.name: playerphysics
modules.description: This mod makes it possible for multiple mods to modify player physics (speed, jumping strength, gravity) without conflict.
